content: Suanah letah thih, Khri letah hring
A cang caco zekhatamaw kaa ta a? Khazing ningdonah cawh pung vy leimei seh tatah suanah cawh kaa tua vy tima maw?
Tua nese bei pei. Suanah letah thi thah peh ka, zekhatamaw ma chung leco kaa ung paria khy thlang a?
Khri Zisu letah baptisma kaa cangpaw khah a thihnah letah baptisma kaa cang tahpaw hnih bei he ceh maw?

Tui chunglang kaa nong tih he peh tah Ama kha phungpai cang peh ka, a thihnah lekhei kaa thi hrah peh. Macawtaco, Khri cawh Paw rungnawnah thongtah patho kaw a cangpaw hratah kaaning zong hringnah a thapaw letah kaa hring a he peh.
Ma hrahei a thihnah letah Ama kha kaa thih hrui caco, a thokawnah letah zong Ama khatah kaa tho hrui hrahring he peh.

Kaa cawngsaw cangnah a paringpaw cawh Khri khatah khraws letah khaipai a cang thah takhah kaa hni. Ma hratei tua a cangpaw cawh a suapaw pung cawh thaw tah suanah sae tah kaa cang khawh lynápaw cawtah a cang.
Zecawtamaw tatah, cawngsaw cawh a thih tihtah sua thawtlungnah chung taikhei a lua.
Khri kha kaa thih hrui thah pawtei a cang caco, Ama kha ka hring hrá peh takhah kaa zing.
Zecawtamaw tatah Khri cawh thihnah taitah patho kaw cang thah ka, thi kaw khaw be takhah kaa hni; thihnah tah a cung letah hmingtuakhynah zehmai hnui khawh be.
A thihnah cawh uikheh teitah a zawnah tai suanah letah a thih. Canghrasala a hringnah cawh Khazing letah a hringpaw a cang.
Ma hraco kaaning zong tah suanah letah thi thah he peh ka, a cang naná tah Khri Zisu thongtah Khazing letah kaa hring peh tatah a rawh my lo.
Macawtaco thih a hmangpaw naa pung khah suanah tah uh khawh kheh seh la, sua dunah lang khah ca zuisah khawh kheh he seh.

Taico naa pungsaw a zehapaw hmai khah hmingchahly tuanah cawtah suanah khah pei khawh khe o. Thihnah taitah hringnah lang patho kawpaw hratah naa hringnah khah Khazing khatah pei la, dingnah tuanápaw hmingbo tutah naa pung ialia tah Khazing kha pei my lo.
Suanah taco ca uh khawh kheh he seh, zecawtamaw tatah phungbia rai letah ung khawh bei he ceh, Khazing ningdonah rai letah pui naa ung thah caw!
Sae cangnah taitah mehding cangnah
A cang caco, zekhatamaw? Phungbia rai letah ung lytah Khazing ningdonah rai letah kaa ung thahnah cawtah suanah cawh kaa tua thlang maw? Cang hrahring be.

Abui pakheh kheh khatah na naw kaa nge a tatah naa peh caco he ceh, naaning cawh ma abui a naw a zuipaw a sae cawh na cang he ceh. Ma hraco suanah cawh a naw naa nge caco, suanah sae cawh cang he ceh ka, suanah tei a chuakhuipaw cawh thihnah a cang; taico ma thly thly hraco Khazing cawh a naw naa zui caco, nawngenah tei a chuakhuipaw cawh dingnah a cang tahpaw hnih bei he ceh maw?
Canghrasala Khazing letah a lawngbia a hlai he peh seh. Zecawtamaw tatah naaning suanah sae a za cangpaw he takhei naa hmuhpaw cawngpahnah hmuisuipaw khah naa lungthing vytei tah naa zui thah.
Suanah sae taitah luasah cang myca he ceh ka, dingnah sae na cang myca he ceh.

Ma hratei tawchingnah bia ka hmangpaw heh naaning tah naa thuithai vy nápawtah ka dunah cawtah a cang. Khuahlai vytei cawh achaw lypaw hming tua pawtah a pialuipaw le chahlynah sae na cang he ceh. Ma thly thly hraco ato cawh mehpathai cang pawtah dingnah sae naa cang ruapaw a cang.
Suanah sae naa za cang ning takhei dingnah khatah a peitle bei he ceh.
Atotei naa zaw khuipaw he ceh hming sahlo lekhei, zeteita amia naa hmuhpaw a ung maw? Ma tlaw sahlo aa changnah cawh thihnah a cang.

Canghrasala atoheh cawh suanah chung taikhei luasah cang myca he ceh ka, Khazing sae na cang myca he ceh, amia naa hmuhpaw cawh Khazing khatah a tlahpaw hringzia cang ka, ma tei a chuakhuipaw cawh chaizaw hringnah a cang.
Zecawtamaw tatah suanah mai cawh thihnah a cang. Canghrasala Khazing lahsong cawh kaa Buipaw Khri Zisu letah chaizaw hringnah a cang.
